title: GroundingTags
description: Output of GroundingTaggerAgent: per-article tags for one query group's search results, including a quality judgement (shouldFilter) used to drop unusable evidence before storyline generation.

groupId.description: The query group id these results belong to.

taggedResults.description: One entry per input search result, same resultId.

resultId.description: Copied verbatim from the input result.

articleType.description: event_report = reports something happened; derivative = interprets a known event; repackage = restates old facts; standalone_resource = tutorial/guide/list.

inferredEventDate.description: The date the reported event actually happened (YYYY-MM-DD), or 'unknown'. NOT publishDate. Push older when unsure.

relevanceToQuery.description: Relevance to the group's userIntent. 5=direct hit, 1=off-topic.

language.description: Primary language code the article is written in, from title+snippet. Allowed: en, zh-hans, zh-hant, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, it, ru, ar, nl, pl, tr, th, vi, id, hi, bn, ur. Unknown/unclear → "en". Downstream matches against the market to drop language-mismatched articles.

isGenericPage.description: True if the url is a generic tool/landing page (domain root, section index, portal, dashboard, product listing, category/tag page) rather than an article. A result with any of the three quality flags true is dropped before storyline generation.

isAggregatorUnresolved.description: True only when the url is a platform aggregator AND the original publisher cannot be identified from title/slug. An aggregator with a recognizable original outlet is false (usable).

isRoundupOrphan.description: True only when the evidence is a roundup/digest bundling many items AND the storyline would pull one bullet with no standalone article backing it. A genre-matched roundup or a depth piece with a number in the title is false.
